Text: God our Father, on this day, You opened the way of eternal life through Your Son's victory over death. [t] Hear our praise; Christ is risen! Alleluia! [*] May every heart hear Your call to share in His resurrection. Conquer the ways of death between us and within us. Make us a new people sharing in His risen life and presence. Renewed by Your Spirit, we will rise with the light of life as we walk in faith
